crop.notes: Clipping is only a caption fragment ('Oscar J. ... The big heavyweight who will meet ...torium') and four lines of the 'Fitz and Corbett' story continued under the McGiboney portrait. The Tom Allen paragraph that follows on the page is not in the clipping.

ocr.notes: OCR matches the small clipping but contains nothing about Allen.

title.suggested: Tom Allen comments on Fitzsimmons-Corbett dispute

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Post-Dispatch asked local sporting men about Fitzsimmons' terms for fighting Corbett; ex-champion Tom Allen appears to have said fighting was different in his day.

metadata.notes: Masthead: Wednesday, St. Louis Post-Dispatch, December 29, 1897, page 5. Same story as article 970 (its continuation).

notes: On the scaled page a paragraph beginning 'Tom Allen: Fighting was different in the days when I was a fighter...' appears below the clipped lines, but it is too small to read verbatim and is outside the crop. Needs a re-crop of the column under the McGiboney portrait; 'at ringside' in the current title/summary is not supported. Consider merging with 970.
